verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਚਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh liv gurmukh sukhafal piram chakhaiaa|

en.bdb: After merging their consciousness in the word of the Guru and the holy congregation, the gutmukhs have tasted the pleasure fruit in the form of contemplation of the Sabad.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਸਭੇ ਫਲ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sabh nidhaan kurabaan kar sabhe fal balihaar karaiaa|

en.bdb: For this fruit, they have offered all the treasures and other fruits also have been sacrificed for the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਣਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਆਂ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: tirasanaa jalan bujhaieeaa(n) saa(n)t sahaj sa(n)tokh dhiRaiaa|

en.bdb: This fruit has quenched all desires and fires and has further firmed up the feeling of peace, equipoise and contentment.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sabhe aasaa pooreeaa aasaa vich niraas valaiaa|

en.bdb: All the hopes have been fulfilled and now the feeling of detachment towards them has come up.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੈ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨ ਧਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: manasaa maneh samailai man kaaman nihakaam na dhaiaa|

en.bdb: The waves of mind have been subsumed in the mind itself and mind now having become free of desires does not run in any direction.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਲ ਜਮਜਾਲ ਕਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: karam kaal jamajaal kaT karam kare nihakaram rahaiaa|

en.bdb: Cutting asunder the rituals and the noose of death, the mind while becoming active has become free of desires for reward.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes aves kar pairee pai jag pairee paiaa|

en.bdb: Getting inspired by the teachings of the Guru, first, the gurmukh fell on the feet of the Guru and then he made the whole world fall cn his feet.
This way, being with the Guru, the disciple has identified Love.
